GeneratedBy.Description: Read EGI NetStation .raw files at 500 Hz with mne.io.read_raw_egi and rewrote each per-block .raw as one BIDS-EEG run. The per-block paradigm mapping is NOT enumerated in Langer et al. 2017, so each block is published as task-blockNN; the paradigm sequence (Resting-state → Surround suppression → Naturalistic viewing → Contrast change detection → Sequence learning → Symbol search) is identical across subjects per the paper but the mapping from block index to paradigm should be confirmed against the CMI MIPDB documentation. Source eye-tracking and behavioural data are preserved in /sourcedata.
